review: 702.6e-1: Jace Beleren had no loyalty counters in the setup, so as an equipped 0/0 creature it would die; it now has 3 loyalty counters and the expected outcome states it is 3/3.

702.6c-2: added; 702.6c's last sentence (the quality does not restrict what the Equipment may stay attached to) had no scenario. The rule never removes an attachment, so the contrast variant is 'other'.

scenarios.title: Equip can be activated only as a sorcery and only targeting a creature you control
decisions: A activates Bonesplitter's equip ability ({1}, tapping Mountain) targeting Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: own_creature_main
variants.expected: The activation is legal: it is A's main phase, the stack is empty and the target is a creature A controls.

variants.label: combat_step
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: equip can be activated only at sorcery timing.

variants.label: opponents_creature
variants.delta: The target is B's Hill Giant instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: Hill Giant is not a creature A controls.

scenarios.title: Equip attaches the Equipment to its target on resolution
decisions: A activates Bonesplitter's equip ability ({1}, tapping Mountain) targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Bonesplitter becomes attached to Grizzly Bears, which is 4/2.

variants.label: target_killed
variants.delta: With the ability on the stack, B casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears (tapping Mountain) before the ability resolves.
variants.expected: Shock resolves first and Grizzly Bears moves to A's graveyard. The equip ability fizzles and Bonesplitter stays on the battlefield unattached.

scenarios.title: An Equip [quality] ability can target only a creature with the quality
decisions: A activates the Equip Knight {1} ability of Steelclaw Lance, tapping Swamp, targeting Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: non_knight_target
variants.expected: The activation is illegal: Grizzly Bears is not a Knight and is not a legal target of Equip Knight.

variants.label: knight_target
variants.delta: The target is Youthful Knight (a Human Knight) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The activation is legal. On resolution Steelclaw Lance attaches to Youthful Knight, which is 4/3 with first strike.

scenarios.title: An Equip [quality] restriction does not restrict what the Equipment stays attached to

setup.notes: Steelclaw Lance was attached to Youthful Knight by its Equip Knight ability on an earlier turn.

decisions: A casts Turn to Frog targeting Youthful Knight, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Turn to Frog resolves.

variants.label: frogged
variants.expected: Youthful Knight is a blue Frog with no Knight type and no first strike. Steelclaw Lance stays attached to it and it is 3/3.

variants.label: not_frogged
variants.delta: A does not cast Turn to Frog.
variants.expected: Youthful Knight stays a Human Knight with first strike; Steelclaw Lance stays attached and it is 4/3.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's Equip restriction (K:Equip:1:Creature.Knight+YouCtrl) applies to targeting only; the attachment check is the generic state-based one.

scenarios.title: Any one of a permanent's equip abilities may be activated
decisions: A activates the Equip {3} ability of Steelclaw Lance, tapping all three Swamps, targeting Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: three_lands
variants.expected: The activation is legal even though A controls no Knight for the other equip ability. On resolution Steelclaw Lance attaches to Grizzly Bears, which is 4/4.

variants.label: two_lands
variants.delta: A controls two Swamps instead of three.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: Equip {3} cannot be paid, and Equip Knight has no legal target.

scenarios.title: Equip planeswalker targets only a planeswalker you control
decisions: A activates the Equip planeswalker {1} ability of Luxior, Giada's Gift, tapping Plains, targeting Jace Beleren.

variants.label: target_planeswalker
variants.expected: The activation is legal. On resolution Luxior attaches to Jace Beleren, which is no longer a planeswalker and is a 3/3 creature (0/0 plus +1/+1 for each of its three loyalty counters).

variants.label: target_creature
variants.delta: The target is Grizzly Bears instead of Jace Beleren.
variants.expected: The activation is illegal: Grizzly Bears is not a planeswalker, and Equip {3} cannot be paid with one Plains.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements this as K:Equip:1:Planeswalker.YouCtrl:planeswalker; how Forge sets the equipped planeswalker's power and toughness needs checking when played.
